_about: The big days of a life: always played, never skipped by a time jump. See src/story/storyDays.js for how they work, and docs/story/ for the story. Days marked draft are planned but need places or people that don't exist yet, so they're skipped for now.

goals.text: Spend Gran's birthday livs at the shop

do.toast: A man in a green coat is standing across the lane, watching your house.
Through the wall, Mum and Gran are arguing in whispers.

end.line: That night, you heard Mum and Gran arguing in whispers. You only caught one word: Corin.
end.remember: The first time you saw the man in the green coat.

goals.text: Take Mum's note to Mr Ambrose's shop

do.toast: Mum gave you a folded note for Mr Ambrose. "Straight there and straight back."

end.line: That week, Mum's dinner plate was always half empty. She said she wasn't hungry.
end.remember: The day you found out how much your family owed Mr Ambrose.
